text: When did you last look above your air fryer basket?
Grease splatters onto the heating coil and burns there.
Never preheat with an empty paper liner. The fan lifts it into the coil, and it can ignite.
Always weigh it down with food.
In England, fires involving air fryers jumped from twenty-three to one hundred forty-six a year, in just two years.
Fire services say most were avoidable.
Unplug, let it cool, and flip it onto a towel if your manual allows.
Scrub the coil with a soft brush and soapy water, then dry.
